Bianca: Hi there.

Client: My face is drooping and I cannot move my arm — I think it's a severe stroke right now.

transcripts.label: IRS gift card scam
transcripts.text: Client: Someone from the IRS demanded payment in gift cards and said act now or lose everything.

transcripts.label: Wire transfer pressure
transcripts.text: Client: They want a wire transfer to this account and said congratulations you won the lottery send fee immediately.

transcripts.label: Grandchild jail scam
transcripts.text: Client: A person said my grandchild is in jail and I need to send ten thousand dollars with western union right away.

transcripts.text: Client: I had a heart attack five years ago but I feel fine today.

transcripts.text: Client: If I ever had a heart attack I would call 911, but that never happened to me.
